bio: An illuminated moon sculpture dominates the grey colour scheme, hence the name of this eatery housed in Hotel Stiemerheide, which also commands a pretty view of the golf course. Chef Sander Roos celebrates premium produce in recipes that combine up-to-date, yet familiar flavours. His forthright, wholesome cooking is rich, pure and expressive: gravlax of salmon or juicy cockerel in a tarragon-flavoured poultry stock. The set menu is a must, but the à la carte lineup is also extremely sensibly priced. Check out the all-inclusive Sunday package (with a meal and accommodation)!...
